solve_greedy_assignment: solve a greedy assignment problem respecting upper bound constraints on each coordinate
run_sorted_knapsack: run a fractional knapsack assignment with lower and upper bounds and a total sum target
solve_fractional_knapsack: solve the fractional knapsack problem maximizing weighted sum subject to interval and simplex constraints
maximize_concave_1d: maximize a concave element-wise function using golden ratio search within given bounds
project_onto_interval_simplex: project a point onto the intersection of a simplex and interval domain constraints
